answer: Attackers who wander in with many fake agents must fund each bond, and collusion costs scale linearly while rewards shrink. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a ferrous-hard collateral bond to register, slashed if duplicate identities emerge. This fable of skin-in-the-game turns mass registration into a capital sink, so legitimate peers verify bonds cheaply and reject unbonded newcomers at the gate. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
